# 10.13.2026 Working with Population Genomics: Class 1

**Overview**

Today, we began working with VCF (Variant Call Format) files, which have two parts:

1.  Header: lines starting with \## that record how the file was made and define every field used in it

2.  Body: one line per variant

We ended with 3.5: Reading a variant record, and have not yet begun 3.6 in the tutorial for Day 1.

# 10.20.2026 Day 3 PopGen

## Overview
Today, we created PCA plots to differentiate populations by latitude, and analyzed data from a previously-run ADMIXTURE. The plots are saved in population_structure folder.

## Notes on Batch Jobs


## Extra

DATA_DIR=users/e/r/erewinke/projects/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/mydata
^ this does not save in the vacc, so must put in every time

We used "module load plink" and then "module list" to get to the module version we're using, which is plink/1.9b7.7
PLINK v1.9.0-b.7.7 64-bit (22 Oct 2024)

Notes on Admixture:
* ADMIXTURE takes a model-based approach to population structure. It assumes our individuals descend from K ancestral populations, each with its own allele frequencies, and estimates the proportion of each individual’s genome that comes from each of them (its ancestry proportions). It uses the same model as the program STRUCTURE but is much faster.
* We don’t know the true K, so we run ADMIXTURE for a range of values and use cross-validation to see which ones fit the data best.

# What I put in terminal to run the batch for today:

nano

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=admixture
#SBATCH --partition=general
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --mem=16G
#SBATCH --time=24:00:00
#SBATCH --output=./logs/%x.%j.out
#SBATCH --error=./logs/%x.%j.err
#SBATCH --mail-type=ALL
#SBATCH --mail-user=erewinke@uvm.edu

cd /gpfs1/home/e/r/erewinke/projects/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myscripts

OUTDIR=/gpfs1/home/e/r/erewinke/projects/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myresults

echo $OUTDIR

VCF=Lottia_gigantea_pl_flt3.renamed.vcf.gz

echo $VCF

module load plink

DATA_DIR=/gpfs1/home/e/r/erewinke/projects/eco_genomics_2026/population_genomics/myresults

VCF=$DATA_DIR/Lottia_gigantea_pl_flt3.renamed.vcf.gz

cd $DATA_DIR

plink --vcf $VCF --double-id --allow-extra-chr \
  --set-missing-var
  --indep-pairwise 50 10 0.2 \
  --out $OUTDIR/Lg_LD_0.2_alldata
  
plink --vcf $VCF --double-id --allow-extra-chr \
  --set-missing-var
  --extract $OUTDIR/Lg_LD_0.2_alldata.prune.in \
  --make-bed --pca --out $OUTDIR/Lg_LD_0.2_alldata
  
echo "my script is done!"
